finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If filePath contains a malicious path or filename, it could lead to OS command injection.
finding.assumptions: The _rootDir variable is assumed to be a trusted directory path. The filePath variable is assumed to be attacker-controlled.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked for any sanitization or validation of the untrusted filePath before it is passed to Path.Combine. No such checks exist in the fragment. However, the sink is File.WriteAllText, which writes data to a file path and does not invoke an OS shell or execute commands. Therefore, even if filePath contains malicious components (e.g., "../" or an absolute path), the operation cannot lead to OS command injection; it may only result in path traversal or unintended file writes. No other checks or constant arguments mitigate the risk, but the nature of the sink itself negates the reported vulnerability.
